spec: A pump.fun sniper / early-buy agent focused on speed. It takes a mint address (or watches for one) and buys in as early as possible with a configurable SOL amount, slippage, and priority fee via the PumpPortal Local Transaction API, signing locally. Before every buy it runs fast safety checks — reject if the dev holds too large a share, if the bonding-curve progress looks like an obvious rug, or if slippage/spend would exceed the configured caps. It supports staggered entries across a few of my own funded wallets, and immediately hands the position to the monitor for take-profit / stop-loss. Optimize for low latency and tight risk. Targets: Claude Code and LangGraph.
